route: flattening screen: complete refutation of drop-k / add-j repairs (replaces R60's bounded VALS enumeration)
target: exact rank <= 22 for 3x3 matrix multiplication over Q/R
proposition: If D = sum_{t=1..j} u_t (x) v_t (x) w_t then for each axis the flattening F_c whose column c is the c-slice of D satisfies F_c = sum_t (u_t (x) v_t) w_t[c]^T, hence dim col(F_c) <= j. Therefore fdim(D) := max over the three axes of dim col(F_axis(D)) is a lower bound on the tensor rank of D, and fdim(D) > j refutes D being a sum of j rank-1 tensors over Q.
whyStrongerThanR60: any rational coefficients admitted, not just VALS = {-2,-1,1,2}
added terms may place values anywhere, including outside the deficit support, as long as they cancel
no work budget: the screen is one exact linear-algebra step per drop set, so it covers 100% of the drop sets
honestLimits: fdim <= j is necessary, not sufficient: each column of the resulting coefficient matrix X must also reshape to a matrix of rank <= 1, which the screen does not test

refutation covers repairs that drop up to maxDrop terms of the named base and add rank-1 terms drawn from Q; a scheme that changes the surviving terms, uses non-rank-1 new factors, or starts from a different base is NOT covered
the Q/R field is the one claimed; the elimination being over Q, the refutations also hold over Z and F_p

families.note: T12c itself is 1/729 wrong, so every D here is nonzero; reaching rank <= 22 needs j <= k
families.verdict: ALL 253 drop sets of size 1..2 are refuted for every j <= k: no repair that drops up to 2 terms of T12c and adds rank-1 terms over Q can reach rank <= 22

families.note: exact rank-23 anchor; reaching rank <= 22 needs j <= k-1, strictly narrower than T12c's j <= k
second exact rank-23 anchor, in a pairwise-disjoint de Groote orbit from T11 (R19)

r57Status: the drop-2-add-2 band R57 left UNRESOLVED is now CLOSED: all 231 two-drop sets of T12c have fdim = 3 > 2, so no pair of rank-1 tensors over Q can supply the deficit, which is strictly wider than the VALS/support ansatz R60 was enumerating
exactArithmetic: rational Gaussian elimination over BigInt via tools/rational.rref; no float equality anywhere
verdictMeaning: a refutation, not a bounded null: every drop-k/add-j repair of T12c with k <= 2 and j <= k is impossible over Q. This says NOTHING about rank-22 schemes that are not of that shape, and does not move the published bounds R >= 19 or R <= 23.
